newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close up on investor optimism.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close up on investor optimism.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed up on Thursday as optimistic investors chose to concentrate on equities after one year T-bill yields fell, brokers said.
The all share index closed 3.6 points up at 613.1. Hayleys rose three rupees to 185, Ceylon Oxygen one to 49.
"The year began with the belief that the worst, caused by the crippling power cuts of 1996, was behind us," said a unit trust manager who declined to be identified.
One year T-bills, which fell to 16.67 percent on Wednesday from 17.94 in mid-November 1996, also helped focus investors on stocks, he said.
"Investors are coming into the stock market, looking for returns of at least 20 percent a year," said the fund manager.
Turnover was 29.8 million rupees on 1.24 million shares. Foreign buying was 16.4 million rupees, while selling was 12.4 million.
